label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.3 a.8 co: No component of anything is the first being: no…
locator: I q.3 a.8 co.: Tertio, quia nulla pars compositi potest esse simpliciter prima in entibus
interpretation: Third reason why God cannot enter into the composition of anything: no part of a composite, neither matter (in potency, posterior to act) nor a participated form (posterior to what is such by essence), can be simply first among beings, and God is 'primum ens simpliciter'. 'Simply first among beings' is read with q.3 a.1's notion of the first being (nothing other is simply prior to it), the notion the reason itself uses. The step from the quarta via's maximality in being to first being is not attributed to q.3 a.8; it is the separate open bridge STMT-MAXIMUM-IN-BEING-IS-FIRST-BEING (Codex P1 on #194). Components are the ComponentOf of q.3 a.7. The first two reasons (from God as first efficient cause) are not formalized.
